updateCompatibilityRule: MUST retain the exact same certificate SHA-256 for all APK/AAB updates to prevent INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE.
keytoolCommand: keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore filtertap-release.keystore -alias filtertap-release-key -keyalg RSA -keysize 4096 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=FilterTap, OU=App, O=FilterTap, C=US"
